job: Take the kitchen trash bag out to the bins at the kerb
understood_as: Pick up the tied kitchen trash bag and carry it out of the building to the bins at the kerb.
steps: Pick up the tied trash bag in the kitchen by its knot using a hook hold
Carry it out of the building to the way out

demos.why: Shows how the hand moves to hook the bag's knot, lift it and carry it clear of the floor.
Shows how firmly to hold the bag so it neither slips nor tears.

unmet: The planner can only carry the bag to the way out of the building, so it cannot place it into the bins at the kerb itself.
